alpha.summary.heading: Things to remember
alpha.kitchen.outro.clingfilm: Raw and Cooked meat should be covered before putting away.
alpha.kitchen.outro.sneeze: If you don't cover your mouth when you sneeze, you can spread harmful microbes.
alpha.kitchen.outro.sneezeHands: Even if you use a tissue when you sneeze, you should wash your hands before handling food.
alpha.kitchen.outro.badFood: If food is mouldy or off, you should throw it away.
alpha.kitchen.outro.burstContainer: If a liquid container is burst you should throw it away.
alpha.kitchen.outro.cookedMeatShelf: Cooked meat should be covered and placed on its own shelf.
alpha.kitchen.outro.rawMeatShelf: Raw meat should have a solid shelf all to itself to prevent harmful microbes transferring to other food.
alpha.kitchen.outro.rawMeatHands: After you handle raw meat, you should wash your hands to prevent harmful microbes from spreading.
alpha.kitchen.outro.fruitLocation: Fruit should be put in the fruit bowl.
alpha.kitchen.outro.vegetablesLocation: Vegetables should be put in the bottom drawer in the fridge.
alpha.kitchen.outro.cheeseLocation: Cheese should go in the top or middle shelf.
alpha.kitchen.outro.cookedMeatLocation: Cooked Meat should go in the top or middle shelf - and have a shelf all on its own.
alpha.kitchen.outro.rawMeatLocation: Raw Meat should go on the solid shelf above the drawers.
alpha.kitchen.outro.liquidsLocation: Liquids should be put in the fridge door.
alpha.kitchen.outro.cupboardItemsLocation: Things like cans and bread should be put in the cupboard.
alpha.kitchen.intro0.0: In this mini-game, you have to put away the shopping.
alpha.kitchen.intro0.3: You need to put things in the right place.
alpha.kitchen.intro0.5: Vegetables go in the bottom drawer of the fridge.
alpha.kitchen.intro0.6: Drinks and Yogurt go in the fridge door.
alpha.kitchen.intro0.7: On the next screen, click on the correct place in the fridge to put away the spring onion.
alpha.kitchen.intro0.10: Try to put away 10 things before the timer runs out.
alpha.kitchen.intro0.11: Click the button when you're ready to start the level...
alpha.kitchen.intro1.1: This time, you also have to put away fruit, tins and bread.
alpha.kitchen.intro1.2: Remember, vegetables go in the bottom drawers in the fridge.
alpha.kitchen.intro1.3: Liquids like milk, yogurt and juice go in the fridge door.
alpha.kitchen.intro1.4: There are some new things this time.
alpha.kitchen.intro1.5: If you see fruit, put it in the fruit bowl.
alpha.kitchen.intro1.6: Tins and bread go in the cupboard.
alpha.kitchen.intro1.7: One more thing - if you start to sneeze, click on the tissues quick! Otherwise, you'll cover the food in harmful microbes.
alpha.kitchen.intro1.8: Click on the button when ready to start.
alpha.kitchen.intro2.1: Things are about to get tricky...
alpha.kitchen.intro2.2: This time, you also have to put away meat.
alpha.kitchen.intro2.3: Meat should always be kept away from vegetables to prevent microbes from spreading.
alpha.kitchen.intro2.4: Click on the cling film to cover meat before putting it in the fridge.
alpha.kitchen.intro2.5: Cooked meat has to have its own shelf.
alpha.kitchen.intro2.6: Raw meat needs to have a solid shelf.  So put the raw meat on the bottom shelf, above the fridge drawers.
alpha.kitchen.intro2.7: Also, if you find cheese, it goes on the top or middle shelf.
alpha.kitchen.intro3.1: Let's see what you can do.
alpha.kitchen.intro3.2: You know all the rules now.
alpha.kitchen.intro3.3: Can you put away all the food correctly?
alpha.kitchen.intro3.5: You have to put away 20 items.
